The specific three-speaker sequence in the cited Mekhilta chapter remains open. Tested the chapter and work-level entries and the exact-name search, without a matching primary witness.

The edition giving Yochai in the cited Kallah report remains uncollated. A digital Kallah Rabbati chapter 2 text names Achai bar Yoshiyah in the separate gaze teaching parallel to Nedarim. That does not establish Heilprin’s reported form in the story context.

The two-name hypothesis remains Heilprin’s conclusion rather than an established split. The Gittin and Kiddushin settings and explicitly literary Shabbat account establish the textual contexts. The deathbed report does not itself date the Setya action to the day Rabbi died.
The exact reported Rashi gloss and identification with bar Yoshiyah remain open. The Berakhot witness gives only Achi. The tested Rashi text did not return the reported phrase.
The passage with Achi Berabbi and the cited Rashi meaning is unlocated. Checked both sides of folio 24 and exact phrase searches.
The reference is to the title or style Berabbi; no unique target was secured. The supplied Bekhorot locator is held; refrain from binding a generic title to a person.
